Horst Systems would like the ability to edit/add Crews and Crew Members on the CSO Planner, or if this is too-hard, then on the Crew Planner. I have provided an descriptions and an AC for each Case.

Best Case - Include Crews on the CSO Planner with the below ACs:
  1. As a scheduler, I want each crew to have a configurable list of crew members, so that when I drag a crew onto a CSO Planner project service order, the crew's default technicians auto-populate as assigned - and I only need to add, remove, or swap the exceptions (Horst estimated ~80% of assignments are the standard crew), instead of manually selecting every technician each time.
    1. Acceptance Criteria:
      1. Crews are associated with a default set of technicians.
      2. Crews can be created and edited on the CSO Planner.
      3. Crews' default Technicians can be added and removed on the CSO Planner.
      4. Assigning the crew on the planner pre-fills technicians from that default set - to be assigned to the Technician Trip as crew members.
      5. The scheduler can remove/replace any pre-filled technician for that specific Technician Trip without changing the default crew members.
      6. The default re-applies fresh for the next assignment/day — it is not "sticky" beyond the one service order/time slot it was set for.
  2. As a scheduler, I want the technician list on the Service Order Planner to show (or be filterable to) only technicians not currently assigned to a service order for the specified day, so I can quickly see who's available to schedule. When I remove someone from a technician trip, they should reappear in this unassigned list automatically.
    1. Acceptance Criteria:
      1. Add a "Crew" tab on the CSO Planner, showing the list of Crews to be scheduled. 
      2. In the "Crew" tab on the CSO Planner, include a tab/list of Technicians ("Technicians Without Crew") not in a Crew for the specified day. These Technicians can therefore, be added to the Crews for the specified day.
      3. When a Technician is not currently assigned to a CSO for the specified day, they will be included in the "Technicians Without Crew" list.
  3. As a scheduler, I want to mark a technician as off/unavailable for a given day, and have the Service Order Planner both surface and enforce that (block or flag the technician assignment), so I can't accidentally schedule someone who has blocked time.
    1. Acceptance Criteria:
      1. Custom.SalesDescription.newValue:
Crew Planner Crew Management

Adds the ability to create new Crews and edit existing Crew membership directly within the Crew Planner, removing the need to navigate to separate NetSuite records to make changes. Users can add or remove Crew Members from an existing Crew and create new Crews inline through a dedicated panel, keeping scheduling and crew configuration within a single interface.

Custom.SuccessMetrics.newValue:
1. A new checkbox is added under System Setup > Scheduling, e.g. "Allow Scheduling Crews on CSO PB".
    1. Default value: unchecked.
    2. When unchecked, the CSO Planner behaves exactly as it does today (Technicians tab only, no crew toggle, no crew scheduling).
    3. When checked, behavior 2–7 below apply.
  2. On the CSO Planner panel, the existing Technicians tab is relabeled Technicians/Crews.
    1.  Clicking the tab shows the technician list as it works today.
    2. Below the tabs, at the top of the panel, a toggle is added to switch between Technicians view and Crews view.
    3. The toggle is only visible when the system setup checkbox is enabled.
  3. In Technicians view, the list only shows technicians who are not a member of any crew.
    1. Technicians who belong to a crew are hidden from this list, regardless of which crew they belong to.
    2. If a technician is removed from all crews, they reappear in this list.
  4. Scheduling a technician from the Technicians view onto a Service Order works exactly as it does today (no change to drag/drop, trip creation, or overlap validation for technicians).
  5. In Crews view, the panel lists crews. Dragging a crew onto a Service Order opens the same scheduling modal used for technician scheduling today, with the following differences:
    1. An inline "Crew Name" field is shown above the technicians list, displaying the selected crew's name.
    2. Below the crew name field, the technicians list shows all technicians currently in the selected crew, pre-selected.
    3. The user can select/unselect technicians in this list to change who gets scheduled to this Service Order for this trip.
    4. Unselecting or adding technicians in this modal does not update the crew record itself (crew membership is unaffected) — the change only applies to this scheduling action.
  6. When confirming the crew assignment, before scheduling, each selected technician is checked for an overlapping scheduled trip or blocked time in the target date/time range.
    1. If any selected technician has an overlap, the assignment is blocked entirely (no partial scheduling of the non-conflicting technicians) and a notification is shown, e.g.: "Technician: Troy Smith is unable to be scheduled to the following Service Order due to an overlapping scheduled trip/blocked time."
    2. If multiple technicians have overlaps, all conflicting technicians are listed in the notification.
    3. This mirrors the existing overlap validation/notification behavior used on the Technician Planner (same conflict-detection logic, reused for each technician in the crew).
    4. If no overlaps are found, the crew is scheduled and a trip/assignment is created for each selected technician on the Service Order.

System.History.newValue:
@Sigi Aisatullin Please review and let me know if I got everything covered. Here are some points about the thought process:
  1. I don't think that development on Crew Planner would work well. On the Crew Planner, we are showing crews on the Y-axis. We cannot edit the crew members there, as it would be applied to any other CSO that would be dragged and dropped to the Crew. So we would need to create crews in the Crew list (just like it was suggested in the related Goley ticket). Anything created and edited from the PB we would consider as temporary changes that would be reset with the new PB session. We could also introduce a flag on the Crew edit if the changes should be permanent or not. I don't think that this would be the most elegant solution, as they will end up creating several variations of one Crew. Especially if they do that very often.
  2. I don't like the 'Technicians without Crews' naming or the logic where we would remove techs that are already scheduled on a CSO. We are going to introduce a utilisation badge next to the techs' names in the list. It is calculated based on the selected date range, so it can be easily seen from the utilization if the technician is already scheduled to smth or not.
